newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine soy forecast cut to 12.8 mln T - source.
newsitem.headline: Argentine soy forecast cut to 12.8 mln T - source.

text.p: The Argentine government's Agriculture Secretariat has cut its estimate of 1996/97 soybean production to 12.8 million tonnes, a market source said Wednesday.
The governmnent decided to cut its estimate from 13.5 million tonnes because of a drought, the source, who did not want to be identified, told Reuters.
But he added that he thought the new figure -- due to be officially announced at a press conference at 1500 local/1400 EST -- was still much too optimistic.
"I've spoken to all the big crushers. Everyone's between 11.2 million tonnes and 11.5 million tonnes," he said.
